# Trusted ecosystem discovery

CRITICAL VISUAL RULE: communicate only through character action, abstract repository objects, color, gates, and spatial filtering. All gates and surfaces must be completely blank. Do not draw the GitHub logo, Octocat/Invertocat silhouette, wordmark, letters, numbers, code, charts, interface controls, badges, or labeled icons.

Create premium animated 16:9 GitHub key art, composed safely inside a 3:2 generation canvas. Render a polished 2.5D animated-film still with GitHub dark-mode atmosphere, cel-shaded characters, contribution-grid texture, repository-like objects, crisp Octicon-inspired geometry, and restrained depth. Use approximately 80% near-black or off-white, 10% neutral gray, 5% GitHub green, and 5% Copilot purple.

Show an animated developer thoughtfully inspecting a broad constellation of reusable repository objects. Funnel those objects through four visually distinct but unlabeled trust gates using shield, balance, boundary, and building-inspired geometry; only a small reviewed set reaches the protected team workspace. The visual POV is broad discovery followed by narrow, evidence-based approval.

Keep the right 38% calm for slide copy and place the character-led review scene on the left. No logos, mascots, generic corporate dashboard, words, letters, fake UI, screenshots, interface panels, or watermarks.
